sources.name: J2ME Loader
sources.notes: Android Java ME emulator candidate; Apache-2.0. Integration still requires a render/input feasibility spike.

sources.name: EKA2L1
sources.notes: Symbian/N-Gage emulator candidate; GPL-3.0. Android support is described upstream as experimental. No firmware is bundled.

sources.name: FreeJ2ME
sources.notes: AWT/SDL2/libretro Java ME alternative, primarily useful for desktop experiments; GPL-3.0-or-later.

sources.name: Nokia Ovi Store
sources.notes: Historical official Nokia store, launched in 2009 and later discontinued. The link is a historical launch announcement, not a current download endpoint.

sources.name: Opera Mobile Store
sources.notes: Historical mobile store, later discontinued. ArchiveTeam is linked as a preservation reference, not as an original live store endpoint.

sources.name: Dedomil
sources.notes: Historical Java mobile game portal candidate. Current catalogue state, delivery behaviour, and package rights have not been verified in this project.

sources.name: ArchiveTeam Mobile Phone Applications
sources.notes: Preservation index page verified as a project reference; individual archive availability and package rights must be checked separately.

sources.name: Kahvibreak
sources.notes: Java ME preservation collection and launcher project. The catalogue being available does not establish redistribution rights for each included title.

sources.name: GetJar
sources.notes: Historical candidate. Current availability of original Java ME catalogue material has not been verified.

sources.name: Sefan.ru
sources.notes: Historical Russian-language WAP portal candidate. Current service status and archive coverage must be checked.

sources.name: Spaces.ru
sources.notes: Historical mobile community and file exchange candidate. Current service status and content rights must be checked.

sources.name: Seclub.org
sources.notes: Historical Sony Ericsson community candidate. Current service status and content rights must be checked.
